b2-mexicosur-01.title: Communicative Challenge: What Is a Cenote?
b2-mexicosur-01.scenario: You are Meg. You and Carlos are watching a documentary about the Yucatán peninsula, and he asks you what a cenote is.
b2-mexicosur-01.prompt: Tell Carlos what a cenote is.
cues: Say that a cenote is a natural well
Say that you can see the water that runs under the ground
b2-mexicosur-01.target: Un cenote es un pozo natural en el que se ve el agua que corre bajo la tierra.
b2-mexicosur-01.english: A cenote is a natural well in which you can see the water that runs under the ground.
b2-mexicosur-01.canDo: I can describe a place or a thing with a relative clause (*que*, *donde*, *en el que*).

b2-mexicosur-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Despite the School
b2-mexicosur-02.scenario: You are Carlos. You have read an article about the languages of Oaxaca and you tell Meg what it says about the 20th century.
b2-mexicosur-02.prompt: Tell Meg that families kept speaking their language even though the school taught in Spanish.
cues: Say that the school taught in Spanish
Say that many families kept speaking their language at home
b2-mexicosur-02.target: A pesar de que la escuela enseñaba en español, muchas familias siguieron hablando su lengua en casa.
b2-mexicosur-02.english: Although the school taught in Spanish, many families kept speaking their language at home.
b2-mexicosur-02.canDo: I can say that something continues in spite of a difficulty, with *a pesar de*, *a pesar de que* and *pese a*.

b2-mexicosur-03.title: Communicative Challenge: What Tequio Does
b2-mexicosur-03.scenario: You are Meg. You are preparing a short talk about community life in Oaxaca, and Carlos asks what tequio is for.
b2-mexicosur-03.prompt: Tell Carlos what is done through tequio.
b2-mexicosur-03.target: Con el tequio se arreglan los caminos y se construyen escuelas.
b2-mexicosur-03.english: With tequio roads are repaired and schools are built.
b2-mexicosur-03.canDo: I can say what is done in a community, without saying who does it, with *se*.

b2-mexicosur-04.title: Communicative Challenge: Why the Caracoles?
b2-mexicosur-04.scenario: You are Carlos. You are reading about the Zapatistas and you explain to Meg why, according to the EZLN, the Caracoles were created.
b2-mexicosur-04.prompt: Tell Meg why the EZLN says it created the Caracoles.
cues: Say that the Caracoles were created in 2003
Say that, according to the EZLN, the communities were to decide about education and health
b2-mexicosur-04.target: Según el EZLN, crearon los Caracoles para que las comunidades decidieran cómo organizar la educación y la salud.
b2-mexicosur-04.english: According to the EZLN, they created the Caracoles so that the communities would decide how to organise education and health.
b2-mexicosur-04.canDo: I can say what someone did so that something would happen, with *para que* and the subjunctive.

b2-mexicosur-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Two Sides of the Train
b2-mexicosur-05.scenario: You are Meg. You are writing a short article about the Maya Train and you give both sides of the debate to Carlos.
b2-mexicosur-05.prompt: Tell Carlos that the train creates jobs but that some communities criticise it.
cues: Say that the train creates jobs
Say that some communities criticise it
b2-mexicosur-05.target: Aunque el tren crea empleos, algunas comunidades lo critican.
b2-mexicosur-05.english: Although the train creates jobs, some communities criticise it.
b2-mexicosur-05.canDo: I can concede a point and then give another with *aunque*, *sin embargo* and *no obstante*.

b2-mexicosur-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: What I Learned About the South
b2-mexicosur-consolidation.scenario: You are Carlos. You and Meg are planning a trip to southern Mexico and you tell her what you have learned about Oaxaca.
b2-mexicosur-consolidation.prompt: Tell Meg two facts about Oaxaca and its communities.
cues: Say how many municipalities Oaxaca has
Say that in many of them the authorities are chosen in an assembly
b2-mexicosur-consolidation.target: Oaxaca tiene 570 municipios, y en más de cuatrocientos las autoridades se eligen en asamblea.
b2-mexicosur-consolidation.english: Oaxaca has 570 municipalities, and in more than four hundred the authorities are chosen in an assembly.
b2-mexicosur-consolidation.canDo: I can describe a cenote or a jungle with a relative clause.
